scope: Five existing audited case studies; research designs only, not newly verified effects

priorities.verifiedStartingPoint: Trilateral missile-warning sharing began operating December 19, 2023.
priorities.attributionTest: Compare actual post-activation sharing latency, coverage and reliability against pre-existing bilateral arrangements, controlling for Japan-ROK normalization.
priorities.costTest: Find agency budget execution, personnel and integration cost by country; distinguish existing bilateral systems from incremental trilateral spend.
priorities.measurableOutcome: Quarterly operational data or publicly disclosed exercise/alert exchange counts; unavailable figures remain null.

priorities.verifiedStartingPoint: March 2023 Beijing statement names China as host and Iraq/Oman as earlier mediators.
priorities.attributionTest: Date Saudi-Iran embassy reopening, ambassador exchanges and security incidents; compare with prior Iraq/Oman negotiation timeline and bilateral incentives.
priorities.costTest: Identify any public Chinese mediation outlays or commitments and Saudi/Iran implementation costs; do not substitute unknown with zero.
priorities.measurableOutcome: Dated restoration of diplomatic missions and bilateral exchange, not China's exclusive causation.

priorities.verifiedStartingPoint: Russia-Belarus security treaty entered into force March 13, 2025.
priorities.attributionTest: Compare treaty articles with pre-existing Union State/CSTO guarantees and independently documented new basing or deployment obligations.
priorities.costTest: Find audited budget allocations, deployments, sanctions effects and Belarusian obligations; distinguish stated commitment from expenditure.
priorities.measurableOutcome: Incremental binding clauses and verified implementation versus prior treaty baseline.

priorities.verifiedStartingPoint: EUPM Moldova financial reference amounts for two separate periods are EUR 13,356,508.08 and EUR 19,817,594.70; these are not actual expenditures.
priorities.attributionTest: Separate 2023 EUPM pre-partnership operations from specific 2024 partnership deliverables; compare Moldovan agency outcomes and EU commitments.
priorities.costTest: Reconcile mission reference budget, appropriations, actual disbursements and Moldovan co-financing for identical periods.
priorities.measurableOutcome: Delivered training, institutional capacity and documented security outputs with matched period and counterfactual.

priorities.verifiedStartingPoint: India-UAE CEPA entered into force in 2022; aggregate bilateral trade alone does not isolate treaty effect.
priorities.attributionTest: Build tariff-line treated-versus-untreated comparisons with matched customs periods and control markets, decomposing price and volume.
priorities.costTest: Estimate foregone tariff receipts, compliance and sector adjustment costs from fiscal records rather than gross trade values.
priorities.measurableOutcome: Tariff-line volumes, unit values and customs receipts in matching fiscal years and valuation bases.

decisionRules: Do not equate signing, hosting, announcement, nominal budget or gross trade with realized net influence.
Require counterpart confirmation and a matched baseline/followup before promoting outcome evidence.
Require documented actual costs and plausible alternative explanations before score eligibility.
Preserve null for unknown metrics; never zero-fill or extrapolate net benefit from gross values.
